references.text: Ziklag is mentioned as the city King Achish gave to David, which later became part of the territory of the tribe of Judah.
Ziklag was the city where David lived and which was attacked by the Amalekites.
In Chronicles, Ziklag is mentioned as one of the cities where the descendants of Simeon lived.
Ziklag is mentioned among the places where the people of Judah settled after returning from exile.
Ziklag is also mentioned as part of the inheritance of Simeon, which was within the territory of Judah.
